Retrieve ILOSTAT data using an SDMX-oriented interface

Source: R/get_ilostat_sdmx.R
get_ilostat_sdmx.Rd

`get_ilostat_sdmx()` provides an SDMX-oriented interface to ILOSTAT datasets while reusing the native Rilostat download, disk-cache and filtering infrastructure.

Usage

get_ilostat_sdmx(
  id = NULL,
  resource = "data",
  component = NULL,
  segment = "indicator",
  type = "code",
  format = "dataframe",
  lang = "en",
  filters = NULL,
  best_source = "yes",
  fixed = TRUE,
  cache_dir = NULL,
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

id

Character. ILOSTAT dataset identifier, for example `"UNE_TUNE_SEX_AGE_NB_A"`. Required for `"data"`, `"structure"` and `"codelist"`. For `resource = "dataflow"`, `id = NULL` returns the complete ILOSTAT dataflow catalogue.

resource

Character. SDMX resource to return. One of: `"data"`, `"structure"`, `"codelist"` or `"dataflow"`.

component

Character. SDMX component identifier used with `resource = "codelist"`, for example `"AGE"`, `"SEX"`, `"OBS_STATUS"` or `"UNIT_MEASURE"`.

segment

Character. Native ILOSTAT segment passed to [get_ilostat()] or [get_ilostat_toc()].

type

Character. Representation of coded values. One of: `"code"`, `"label"`, `"label_short"` or `"both"`.

`"code"` returns SDMX codes.

`"label"` replaces coded values with their labels.

`"label_short"` uses short/display labels when available.

`"both"` returns codes together with companion `*_LABEL` columns.

format

Character. Output format. One of: `"dataframe"`, `"sdmx-ml"` or `"sdmx-json"`.

`"sdmx-ml"` and `"sdmx-json"` are available for the structural resources `"structure"`, `"codelist"` and `"dataflow"`. Observation data are currently returned as a data frame.

lang

Character. Language used for labels. One of `"en"`, `"fr"` or `"es"`.

filters

Named list of filters using SDMX component identifiers, for example `REF_AREA`, `SEX`, `AGE`, `FREQ`, `MEASURE` and `TIME_PERIOD`.

Ordinary component filters reuse native Rilostat matching semantics. For example, `SEX = "SEX_F"` filters female observations.

`FREQ` and `MEASURE` are dataset-level SDMX constants. A filter that does not match the dataset returns an empty SDMX data frame.

`TIME_PERIOD` supports the existing Rilostat time filtering semantics. Equality can be expressed directly, for example `TIME_PERIOD = "2020"`, while comparison operators can be supplied as a named list, for example `TIME_PERIOD = list(ge = "2020", le = "2023")`.

Ordinary coded components also support `eq` and `ne`, for example `SEX = list(ne = "SEX_T")`.

best_source

Character. Source-selection behavior passed to [get_ilostat()]. `"yes"` (default) returns best-source observations and does not expose `BEST_SOURCE`; `"no"` and `"all"` retain the `BEST_SOURCE` component.

fixed

Logical. Native matching behavior passed to [get_ilostat()].

cache_dir

Character or `NULL`. Directory used for the SDMX metadata disk cache and native Rilostat cache. If `NULL`, the standard Rilostat cache location is used.

refresh

Logical. If `TRUE`, refresh cached dataset metadata and request a refresh of the native ILOSTAT data cache.

Value

The return value depends on `resource` and `format`.

With `format = "dataframe"`, a data frame is returned.

With `format = "sdmx-ml"`, a character string containing SDMX-ML 3.1 is returned.

With `format = "sdmx-json"`, a character string containing SDMX-JSON 2.1 is returned.

Details

The existing [get_ilostat()] function remains the native ILOSTAT interface. `get_ilostat_sdmx()` adds an SDMX semantic layer whose components are derived dynamically from dataset metadata.

For `resource = "data"`, native ILOSTAT column names are mapped to SDMX component identifiers. Dynamic classifications are obtained from the dataset metadata rather than hard-coded. For example, a native `classif1` column can become `AGE` when the dataset metadata identifies that dimension as age.

The data resource includes the SDMX message envelope components `STRUCTURE`, `STRUCTURE_ID` and `ACTION`. `STRUCTURE_NAME` is also returned when labels are requested.

Dataset-level components such as `FREQ`, `MEASURE`, `UNIT_MEASURE` and `UNIT_MULT` are derived from the dataset SDMX metadata.

`resource = "codelist"` returns the canonical ILOSTAT codelist associated with the requested SDMX component.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{

# Observation data using SDMX component names
x <- get_ilostat_sdmx(
  "UNE_TUNE_SEX_AGE_NB_A",
  filters = list(
    REF_AREA = "FRA",
    SEX = "SEX_F",
    AGE = "AGE_YTHADULT_YGE15"
  )
)

# Codes and labels
x <- get_ilostat_sdmx(
  "UNE_TUNE_SEX_AGE_NB_A",
  type = "both",
  filters = list(
    REF_AREA = "FRA",
    SEX = "SEX_F"
  )
)

# Time range
x <- get_ilostat_sdmx(
  "UNE_TUNE_SEX_AGE_NB_A",
  filters = list(
    REF_AREA = "FRA",
    TIME_PERIOD = list(
      ge = "2020",
      le = "2023"
    )
  )
)

# Dataset structure
structure <- get_ilostat_sdmx(
  "UNE_TUNE_SEX_AGE_NB_A",
  resource = "structure"
)

# Canonical AGE codelist
age <- get_ilostat_sdmx(
  "UNE_TUNE_SEX_AGE_NB_A",
  resource = "codelist",
  component = "AGE"
)

# One Dataflow
flow <- get_ilostat_sdmx(
  "UNE_TUNE_SEX_AGE_NB_A",
  resource = "dataflow"
)

# Complete ILOSTAT Dataflow catalogue
flows <- get_ilostat_sdmx(
  resource = "dataflow"
)

# SDMX-ML 3.1 structure message
xml <- get_ilostat_sdmx(
  "UNE_TUNE_SEX_AGE_NB_A",
  resource = "structure",
  format = "sdmx-ml"
)

# SDMX-JSON 2.1 structure message
json <- get_ilostat_sdmx(
  "UNE_TUNE_SEX_AGE_NB_A",
  resource = "structure",
  format = "sdmx-json"
)
} # }
